title: Cocktails And Stories From Pike Place Market
includes: Samples from around Pike Place Market
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Seattle has no shortage of food tours or cocktail bars — Market-to-Glass Cocktail Adventure is unlike anything else you’ll find in the city.

Guided Market Discovery – You’ll shop Pike Place Market with our world-famous cocktail designer, meeting the vendors whose ingredients make Seattle’s flavors unforgettable.

With a Master – You’ll explore and learn with a true Market insider — and learn the Four Families of Cocktails, the foundation every great drink belongs to.

Your ticket includes admission to a private cocktail class that begins with a guided Pike Place Market ingredient walk and concludes with an instructional cocktail session in a private setting.

Guests explore the four foundational cocktail families through four Pike Place–inspired designer cocktails, each crafted using ingredients sourced directly from the Market and sampled as part of the class.

Cocktail samples are complimentary and included. Alcohol is not sold separately.
